title: Argentina Yoga Retreat : Buenos Aires & Patagonia

teachers.name: Alison Buchanan
bio: Alison’s motto is “strength comes from within.” By leading from the heart, and believing in our innate power, she feels that every one of our goals is achievable.

Alison brings this philosophy to her teaching, where she aims to create challenging, yet playful sequences. Her classes are holistic and mindful, and always tuned to what students need in the moment. Deep down, Alison is an alignment and anatomy nerd who loves to share her knowledge with the aim of helping people move better, and thus feel better, in their bodies.

Before moving to Seattle, Alison was a longtime teacher in the San Francisco Bay Area. She has taught yoga professionally for 13 years, and continues to advance her yogic studies with dynamic asana and mediation teachers nationwide. During yoga retreats with Alison, you can expect her to be an engaged leader who offers a strength-focused yoga class in the morning, and a restorative/meditation class in the evening. She’ll be a person with whom you can authentically connect on-and-off the mat. She’ll also be an active participant, who’ll happily go adventuring with you, and then reminisce about it all over a glass a wine at the end of the day.
Come experience adventure, excitement, restoration and all-around fun with her on a life-changing retreat.

intro: Join us for an unforgettable 7 night adventure that begins in the vibrant and historic city of Buenos Aires and continues in the breathtaking beauty of Patagonia’s Villa La Angostura. Your journey starts with three nights in Buenos Aires, where you’ll experience the energy of this iconic city with daily yoga sessions, exquisite food and wine, and immersive city tours that capture the heart and soul of Argentine culture. Enjoy a unique retreat adventure and immerse yourself in the rich history and vibrant spirit of Buenos Aires.
about_body: Our extraordinary 7-night yoga and adventure retreat takes you from the lively streets of Buenos Aires to the serene landscapes of Villa La Angostura in Patagonia. Our adventure begins with four days in Buenos Aires, a city bursting with life and history. Here, you’ll enjoy daily yoga practices, savor delicious Argentine cuisine paired with fine wines, and explore the city’s rich cultural heritage through guided tours, tango performances and secret speakeasys. Experience the thrill of playing polo, one of Argentina’s most cherished sports, and immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of this remarkable city.

After soaking in the dynamic energy of Buenos Aires, we’ll whisk you away to the peaceful surroundings of Villa La Angostura in Patagonia for the next four nights. This stunning retreat, set amid crystal-clear lakes and towering mountains, offers daily yoga sessions in nature’s embrace, scenic hikes, unique excursions and ample time to relax and recharge in a tranquil setting. Fresh, locally sourced meals and the best of Argentine wines nourish you daily as you unwind by the water.
Literally the best of both worlds…we are so excited to share this amazing country with you!

travel_tips.heading: Argentina yoga retreat : Buenos Aires & Patagonia
items: AIRPORT INFO : Buenos Aires has 2 Airports : EZE that serves International flights & AEP that serves domestic flights and some South America flights. EZE is approx 45 minutes & AEP is approx 15 minutes from our hotel in the city. For departures, we will not have the return flight times from Patagonia until 4 months prior to retreat dates when you purchase your tickets. If you want to purchase your international flights for Buenos Aires sooner than 4 months out and want to make sure the flight times jive, you can plan to leave from Buenos Aires (EZE) to your international destination in the late evening/night of closing day or plan to stay overnight in BA and leave the following morning. Please keep in mind you will have to change airports from AEP to EZE to fly out to the US or your home country. This ride is approx 1 to 1.5 hours. We will help coordinate groups together to share taxis once we have everyone’s flight details so you can plan to ride together. You will be responsible for getting your own taxi from the AEP airport after the retreat ends.

AIRPORT TRANSFERS : You can take a taxi from the EZE terminal upon arrival right to our first hotel in the city. EZE is about 45 minutes from the hotel and AEP is about 15 minutes. Rates will be based on the taxi meter. Please keep in mind for your return flights to Buenos Aires and then to your final international destination, you will have to change airports from AEP to EZE. This ride is approx 1 to 1.5 hours. Airport transfers are NOT included in the package but we will help coordinate groups together to share taxis once we have everyone’s flight details so you can plan to ride together. You will be responsible for getting your own taxi from the AEP airport after the retreat ends.

WEATHER : Seasons in Argentina are opposite from North America, so our Spring is their Fall and our Fall is their Spring. Please plan to dress in layers for all kinds of weather situations. There could be rain and both hotels have swimming pools and the VLA location has a jacuzzi too. The lake will be cold no matter what time of year but if you’re feeling a cold plunge calling…this is your chance!

WHAT TO PACK : Layers are always recommended to transition from sunny days to cooler evenings. Jeans, light sweaters or jackets should be handy for cooler evenings while day time can be sunny and mild. Comfortable shoes are recommended and heels should be carefully considered because of the uneven cobblestone streets that you will surely encounter. A bathing suit and something to lay on top of in the sand if you plan to hang out by the lake is recommended. Bring a rain jacket and umbrella just in case. We will be hiking in nature so something sturdy for this walk is recommended.

YOGA PROPS : We will be practicing at a studio in Buenos Aires so mats and props are provided. In Patagonia a yoga mat will be provided for your use. If you like to practice on your own mat and are looking for an amazing travel mat we highly recommend Liforme mats and knee pads. You can use this link to get an additional 5% discount on your order.

DIETARY CONCERNS : Argentina is a culture that goes heavy on the meats..that said, in most cases they are willing to offer vegetarian options and at times can accommodate vegan as well. We ask that you be flexible in terms of diet as much as possible. Gluten free and specific food allergies will be easier to consider but anything serious will be difficult to control given the risk of cross-contamination in the kitchens while preparing meals. If you have a serious allergy please bring at least 2 epi-pens with you, carry them with you at all times and let us know where they are located so we may assist you in case of an emergency.

TRAVEL INSURANCE AND TRIP CANCELLATION COVERAGE : We highly recommend you immediately purchasing travel insurance and Trip Cancellation coverage as soon as you make your deposit towards travel to cover your investment in case anything should go awry with your travel plans.

faqs.question: Do you accept bitcoin?
answer: In addition to credit card payments we also accept wire transfers, Zelle and Bitcoin. Please inquire for more details.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
answer: All payments are 100% non refundable and non-transferable. We recommend that you buy trip cancellation insurance immediately upon making your initial deposit to cover any travel hiccups or complications that may arise between now and the time of your retreat. No exceptions are possible so please cover your trip by connecting with an insurance company that offers the right policy for you.

faqs.question: What happens if my travel plans change?
answer: There are no refunds as per our cancellation policies. We highly recommend that all of our guests secure a quality travel insurance that will cover them for any event which may cause a change of travel plans, including personal health issues or personal situations in general which may affect travel plans.

faqs.question: Are flight delays or cancellations covered?
answer: Not by us: transportation delays, cancellations or changes due to strikes, labor disputes, or lockouts from airlines, boats, ferries or any type of transportation are among the events we recommend covering with travel insurance.

faqs.question: Where can I find the full terms & conditions?
answer: The full terms and conditions are published at https://yogaadventuresworldwide.com/termsandconditions/ . By submitting payments toward your retreat you accept them.

booking.deposit_instructions: Deposits of $1,000usd are due to secure your space in the retreat. Please check availability with us for accommodations before making your deposit.
booking.balance_note: The balance of your retreat (minus your $1,000usd initial deposit) is due 90 days prior to arrival. All details with instructions for settling up will be emailed to you three months prior to the retreat.
booking.roommate_note: Roommates should book together. If you would like to share a room and do not have a roommate we will provide one for you if possible. In the case that there is no one to share a room we ask that you take a private room instead.
